effect.menu-tip: Write a PES for the Brother PE900 plus an editable Ink/Stitch SVG working file

param.name: output-dir
param.gui-description: Folder for the PES machine file and the editable .inkstitch.svg working file.

param.name: base-name
param.gui-description: Base name without extension. Leave empty to use the document name.

param.name: also-dst
param.gui-description: Useful when sharing with digitizers; DST does not store thread colours.

page.name: info
page.label: Prepare for PE900
One step for the Brother PE900: hoop check, sew-order receipt, PES for the machine, and an editable .inkstitch.svg so next week's name change does not start from a flat stitch file.
Tip: run Edit → Color Order first when you have merged several purchased designs, so the PES has fewer thread changes.
